name: Sonic Terror
storyline:
In an alternate 1984, the authorities of a tiny totalitarian Republic have united with an alien life form to keep people on a short leash. Everything went out of control. Spreading across the land, the threat can only be stopped with music. You are the last band around. If you lose, the whole planet will be silenced and consumed.

Take control over a young rock band, develop their skills and personalities, seek inspiration and compose new songs to fight against evil. Decide whether it's a tour of partners in crime — or a misadventure of rivaling degenerates.

Get on your tour bus with a mysterious driver behind the wheel, and take a ride into the eye of the storm to sabotage the vicious plan of the invaders and their human supporters. Explore a handcrafted world following the dynamic twisted storyline, save the Earth and find the truth about real reasons behind the events of the game.
summary:
Sonic Terror is a turn-based tactical RPG where music is brutal magic and the only weapon against a space alien parasite that has turned silence into a new law.
Set in an alternative 1984, Sonic Terror puts you in control of an outlaw rock band on tour through a totalitarian Republic invaded by body-snatching aliens. The only thing they’re afraid of is music—and you’re the last ones to play it.
